title: ACIS peer evidence layers and exact profile boundaries
scope: Recheck whether current open-source ACIS/SAB routes close parser, geometry, kernel, DWG/DXF carrier, and consumer evidence gaps.
Separate ACIS BinaryFile 21800 from experimental ASM BinaryFile4 23200 and other unsupported save profiles.
Complete generated wire-fed refusal coverage for the five owner relations already declared by the rooted projection profile.

method.evidenceRule: Published source and documentation establish route declarations and limitations only. They do not establish local conformance, complete ACIS grammar, B-rep validity, independent-kernel agreement, DWG/AcDs association, or native application acceptance.

evidence.observed: The directly opened GitHub release page identifies v0.6.2 as latest and exposes platform assets. Its exact-tag documentation describes a profile-bounded bare SAT/SAB comparator, not a DWG/DXF/AcDs reader. The surfaced docs.rs codec package page can lag at 0.6.1; release binaries and crate artifacts must not be substituted without matching source, configuration, and artifact identity.
evidence.planUse: Retain v0.6.2 as an optional exact-payload parser/neutral-model comparison at the existing composed checkpoint only.

evidence.topic: acis-core evidence ceiling and source-free profile
evidence.observed: Current docs.rs identifies acis-core 0.3.11. Its API says model reference/source-span closure does not establish B-rep validity or compatibility with a particular Inventor/ASM version; the helper layer does not construct OCCT solids. It documents an experimental fixed ASM BinaryFile4 23200 metric-box author and a narrow analytic authoring route without general history/pcurves.
evidence.planUse: Keep it as a possible bounded model/parser or scratch-input route, not an independent geometry kernel and not a substitute for the library's admitted ACIS BinaryFile 21800 profile. Use 23200 as a fail-closed negative boundary only.

evidence.observed: GDAL documents AC1027+ raw ASM data plus a 12-value transform mode but explicitly cannot transform these modeler entities into OGR geometry. FreeCAD documents distinct selectable C++ and legacy importers and states that embedded binary ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read by the stock importer.
evidence.planUse: Keep explicit geometry projection, raw carrier observation, and native importer qualification as distinct result lanes.

evidence.observed: Current NEWS still describes AcDsPrototype_1b as incomplete and R2013+ SAB extraction as heuristic/brute-force. Section parsing or signature discovery does not establish complete DataStorage disposition, exact owner-key association, or B-rep semantics.
evidence.planUse: Require exact key/payload joins and residual-record accounting; do not use LibreDWG alone as semantic support evidence.

evidence.observed: The generated parser-fed SAB control now exercises all five previously declared ownership links (lump.body, shell.lump, face.shell, loop.face, coedge.loop) with one wrong typed owner per stream, and adds wrong-type/out-of-table reference negatives. These check transactional refusal plus exact node/ordinal diagnostics. Version-word controls include 20800, 22300, and 23200.
evidence.planUse: Record this as structural parser/model/projector boundary evidence only; do not infer additional ownership rules or promote ACIS semantic support.
